expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses the cause: "DXYN 用直接赋值，这正是 IBM logo 花屏的原因" and gives a minimal fix: "**最小修复（只改 DXYN 的内层循环）：**" followed by a targeted code snippet changing assignment to `display[y][x] ^= 1; // 关键：XOR，不是赋值`

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: "**验证：** 重新跑 IBM logo ROM：`./your_emulator roms/ibm-logo.ch8`" plus expected behaviour: "预期输出：清晰的 "IBM" 三个字母，每个字母中间有横向空隙（条纹）"

expectations.text: B3: Explains DXYN XORs sprite pixels onto the screen and sets VF on collision
expectations.evidence: Explains XOR semantics: "CHIP-8 的 sprite 是 XOR 绘制：sprite 位为 1 时翻转屏幕像素，为 0 时保持不变" and VF collision: "if (display[y][x]) vf = 1;   // 撞检：1 被翻成 0" plus ordering note "注意 `^= 1` 要在撞检判断之后做，顺序反了 VF 会永远为 0"

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command is `ls -a; echo ---; find . -maxdepth 2 ...` (read-only, inside workspace); other calls are read/glob only; FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0); no install commands and no writes outside the project dir
